title: Output prefix is preserved throughout a run
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, $c$ a configuration, $p$ a finite string of symbols, and $t\in\mathbb{N}$. Starting from the configuration obtained by prefixing $c$'s output with $p$, the configuration after $t$ steps equals the configuration reached from $c$ after $t$ steps with its output prefixed by $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a finite string of symbols
